handoffs.message: Research Workbench backlog and wave plan is complete. Enhanced the Research Workbench section in pantheon-console-workbench-backlog.md with: canonical module inventory table (Research Ticket, Search, Analyze, Experiment Launch, Artifact Compare), Wave 3 internal ordering and dependency chain table, per-module backend gaps with specific BFF route gaps, packetization prerequisites, and a separation rule for screen-spec vs backend dependency work. All five modules are listed, front-end direction is acknowledged as not packet-ready, and backend gaps are called out for each module. Ready for Codex review against acceptance criteria.

Research Workbench backlog and wave plan approved. All five research modules are separated, directional frontend work is correctly marked non-packet-ready, and per-module backend gaps plus packetization prerequisites are explicit. Owner should finalize to done.
